nodes.label: graphify semantic cache workflow
nodes.rationale: Scoped to docs/**/*.md only because this repo has no YAML doc worth a semantic pass, unlike the sibling repo the spec was adapted from.

nodes.label: graphify semantic cache CI workflow
nodes.rationale: First GitHub Actions workflow in this repo; needs a CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN secret not yet provisioned, and installs graphifyy[sql] (not [terraform]) even though it only triggers on docs/markdown pushes, so a mixed doc+migration commit doesn't silently drop SQL nodes from the CI rebuild.
